use: along the line at the fryer and control desk
note: Web copy at 0.7500 x the render; all *_px values and px_per_* are already scaled to this image. Web cutouts (public/art/characters) are 768 x 1152 with feet at 97 % of the height. Character cutouts (crc-learning-game assets-and-references/characters/*/scenes, 1024 x 1536, feet at ~97 % of the image height, head near the top): scale = person_px / (0.97 * cutout_height_px) where person_px = person_175_px scaled by the character's height / 1.75 m; place the cutout so its bottom edge is at feet_y_px + 0.03 * scaled_height (interpolate person_175_px / feet_y_px between rows). The table is projection only: it says nothing about furniture or walls, so pick a spot with clear floor (or draw foreground objects over the character with a mask). Rows are measured straight ahead of the camera; for this roll-free camera a figure standing anywhere on the same image row has the same height (only its width foreshortens towards the frame edges).
